- 1 tablespoon sugar
- 1/4 teaspoon salt
- 1 cup non-dairy milk (such as almond, soy, or coconut milk)
- 1 tablespoon vegetable oil
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

4. Heat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat.
